# Favorites · DSH Right Sidebar Plugin
中文说明
Save URLs in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar, organize them by category, and drag links between c
ategories to organize them.
## Author

- Author: Jeckun
- Date: 2026-11-05
- License: MIT (see LICENSE)
## Features
- Adds a "Favorites" tab to the right sidebar's start page; shortcut: `Ctrl+Shift+P` (`Cmd+Shift+P`

on macOS).
- Shows a title, favorite count, and an add menu (add link / create category).
- Categori

es can be collapsed, renamed, and deleted; deleting a category moves its links to "Uncategorized".
-

Drag category rows to reorder them; a dark gray horizontal line indicates the drop position.
- Add,

edit, and delete links; click an icon to open its URL in a new tab.
- Drag link icons between categ
ories or within a category to reorder them; a gray vertical line indicates the insertion point. Coll

apsed categories expand automatically when a link is dragged onto them.
- Data is stored in browser

`localStorage` (`dsh.favorites.v1`) and persists across refreshes and restarts.
- On first use, adds
`DeepSeek Api` → `https://platform.deepseek.com/usage` to "Uncategorized"; no user categories are p
Api` → `https://platform.deepseek.com/usage` to "Uncategorized"; no user categories are pre-created.

## Installation
Installed locally in:

- The `link:` dependency in `C:\Users\jecku\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`
- The `favorites` ro
w in `C:\Users\jecku\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml`
If "Favorites" does not appear in the current window, refresh the page (`Ctrl+R`). If it still does
not appear, restart DSH.
## Usage

1. Open a conversation and expand the right sidebar.
2. Click "Favorites" on the start page.
3. Clic

k "Add" in the upper-right corner, then choose "Add link" or "Create category".
4. Expand a category
and drag a link icon to another category to move it. Drag within the same category to reorder links

; a gray vertical line indicates the insertion point.
5. Drag a category row to reorder categories;
a dark gray horizontal line indicates the drop position.
